entities.summary: Jaylon O'Neal Ferguson was an American professional football player who was a linebacker in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Louisiana Tech Bulldogs before being selected by the Baltimore Ravens in the third round of the 2019 NFL draft. He played three seasons with the Ravens.
